paper.title_en: Dissipative Effects in Transmission Line Analogues of Hawking Radiation
paper.abstract_en: Hawking radiation is a fundamental result of quantum field theory in curved spacetime, yet its direct observation remains beyond current experimental capabilities. Circuit quantum electrodynamics provides a practical platform for realizing analogue systems where Hawking-like radiation may be studied under controlled laboratory conditions. In this work, we analyze two superconducting-circuit analogues of Schwarzschild black holes: a tunable dc-SQUID transmission line and a SNAIL-based transmission line supporting solitonic solutions of the KdV equation. We investigate the conditions under which these architectures can generate an observable Hawking temperature and study the impact of dissipation and thermal noise using an open quantum systems approach. To assess the observability of the Hawking signal, we propose complementing particle number measurements with estimates of the Hilbert-Schmidt distance to the thermal bath. Our analysis establishes practical detectability thresholds and shows that Hawking temperatures above approximately 73 mK remain distinguishable under realistic experimental conditions. While the tunable transmission line architecture can reach temperatures of about 113 mK and therefore appears more viable, the solitonic model requires further optimization and more demanding experimental conditions.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文以开放量子系统方法分析超导电路（可调dc-SQUID传输线与SNAIL传输线）中的霍金辐射类比，明确给出可观测性阈值（约73 mK）、两架构可达温度（约113 mK）及限制，理论与实验结合紧密，对该主题读者有明确的点击价值。
decision.title_zh: 霍金辐射传输线类比中的耗散效应
decision.abstract_zh: 霍金辐射是弯曲时空量子场论的一个基本结果，但其直接观测仍超出当前实验能力。电路量子电动力学为在受控实验室条件下实现类比系统、从而研究类霍金辐射提供了一个实用平台。在本工作中，我们分析了史瓦西黑洞的两种超导电路类比：一种可调dc-SQUID传输线和一种基于SNAIL的传输线，后者支持KdV方程的孤子解。我们研究了这些架构能够产生可观测霍金温度的条件，并使用开放量子系统方法研究了耗散与热噪声的影响。为评估霍金信号的可观测性，我们提出在粒子数测量的基础上补充对到热浴的Hilbert-Schmidt距离的估计。我们的分析确立了实际可探测性阈值，并表明在现实实验条件下，高于约73 mK的霍金温度仍可区分。虽然可调传输线架构可以达到约113 mK的温度，因而看起来更可行，但孤子模型需要进一步的优化和更苛刻的实验条件。
